name: SearchIoc
description: Pivot from an indicator of compromise (IP, domain, TTP or imphash) to the PolySwarm artifacts associated with it, the pivot capability the PolySwarm app for Splunk has and this integration otherwise lacks. Wraps api.search_by_ioc, which accepts exactly one of the four indicator types. This action only reads and spends no scanning quota.

ip.description: Pivot on this IP address: return the artifacts PolySwarm has seen communicate with it. This action only reads and spends no scanning quota. Supply exactly one of ip, domain, ttp or imphash.

domain.description: Pivot on this domain: return the artifacts PolySwarm has seen communicate with it. This action only reads and spends no scanning quota. Supply exactly one of ip, domain, ttp or imphash.

ttp.description: Pivot on this TTP identifier, as PolySwarm's sandbox analysis records it: return the artifacts associated with it. This action only reads and spends no scanning quota. Supply exactly one of ip, domain, ttp or imphash.

imphash.description: Pivot on this import hash (imphash): return the artifacts PolySwarm has seen share it. This action only reads and spends no scanning quota. Supply exactly one of ip, domain, ttp or imphash.

found.description: Whether PolySwarm returned at least one artifact for the indicator

indicator_type.description: Which of ip, domain, ttp or imphash was supplied

indicator.description: The indicator value that was searched for

results.description: Artifacts PolySwarm associates with the indicator. Empty when PolySwarm has never seen it.

sha1.description: SHA1 hash of the artifact, when the document carries one

md5.description: MD5 hash of the artifact, when the document carries one

malicious_detections.description: Number of engines that returned a malicious verdict

benign_detections.description: Number of engines that returned a benign verdict

total_detections.description: Total number of engines that returned a verdict

polyscore.description: PolySwarm threat score (0.0 - 1.0), when the document carries one

permalink.description: Link to the PolySwarm scan result

family.description: Malware family name, when the metadata carries one

families.description: Every malware family PolySwarm associates with the artifact. Empty when PolySwarm carries no family.

tags.description: Tags PolySwarm associates with the artifact. Empty when there are none.

first_seen.description: First seen timestamp, when the document carries one

last_scanned.description: Last scanned timestamp, when the document carries one

mimetype.description: MIME type of the artifact, when the document carries one

filenames.description: Filenames PolySwarm has seen for the artifact

returned_count.description: Number of artifacts returned in results

outputs.found: PolySwarm returned at least one artifact for the indicator
outputs.not found: PolySwarm has never seen this indicator
